text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Project Overview lists the total approved budget as $2,400,000.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown states that, following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 to account for additional smart TV integration costs not included in the original scope."}]},{"text":"The change is an increase of $200,000, from $2,400,000 to $2,600,000.","kind":"derived","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 to account for additional smart TV integration costs not included in the original scope."}]},{"text":"The Team & Governance Document states that budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation, and the Budget & Timeline Breakdown says the Finance Committee revised the budget.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"GOV-p1-s2","quote":"Decisions requiring budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee before implementation."},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000"}]}],"conflicts":[{"topic":"Total project budget","claim_indexes":[0,1]}],"missing":[],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
